title: improv·artist · cosmic (Refik Anadol)
mutation_directive: improv artist: cosmic via Refik Anadol

improv_extras.practice: data sculptures; AI-driven flow fields, memory of buildings, cosmic dust

v1.feedback: Fragment shader won't compile — `vec0.5` must be `vec2(0.5)`, so the piece renders nothing. Even fixed, this is a glowing additive-blend particle nebula with radial arms: exactly the curl-noise cloud failure mode the brief penalizes. Anadol's signature is data encoded into architectural or sculptural form (building facades, topographic surfaces, data-driven morphology) — none of that is here, just a sphere with filaments and comments that say 'Anadol.' To rescue: replace the isotropic sphere with a recognizable silhouette (building cross-section, columnar data-stack, toroidal surface) and let the flow field deform that form rather than filling empty space with ambient particles.

v2.feedback: The torus reads clearly within 2 seconds and the Anadol data-sculpture concept lands — flowing particles on a morphing toroidal surface with emanation wisps is a legitimate interpretation of his cosmic-dust / data-as-material practice. The restrained deep-ocean blue palette is disciplined and the wireframe scaffold adds architectural depth without clutter. To push further: the surface displacement is purely sinusoidal and reads as a wobbly rubber ring rather than data-driven turbulence — mixing in a few octaves of curl-noise displacement keyed to the aData attribute would sell the 'memory of data' concept. The camera orbit is slow and steady but never zooms into the surface detail where the 600 filament threads live; consider a second camera phase that dips closer to the tube wall so those Shiota-thread lines and emanation particles get their moment.
